title: CLO 2025.1 New Features Highlights Video - A Quick Tour of the Intelligence and Power of the New Version!
description:
The smarter and more powerful CLO 2025.1 new version is officially launched! In this version, we have developed new features based on user feedback to make your garment creation workflow more efficient!

The new version brings the following core features: CLO AI Studio, denim wash effect presets, seamless zoning, upgraded 3D pen, CLO zFab Fabric Measurement Kit x CLOFAB, zipper tab added to the object window, and seamless integration of CLO-SET and CONNECT experiences.

Experience the power of the new features online with CLO technology experts and revolutionize your imagination!
transcript:
Hello everyone, this video is to introduce the new features of KOLO 2025.1.

First, the main features:

Use our 3D pen virtual model tool to draw directly on the model. Even if you don’t know how to do it, you can freely unleash your creativity in KOLO, allowing you to create three-dimensional costumes.

This update upgrades the tool so that not only can you draw on the virtual model, but by using shortcut keys, you can start drawing off the surface of the virtual model and draw anywhere in 3D space. All other common shortcuts remain usable.

Additionally, there are some new functions, such as adding a circle around the virtual model and displaying the distance from the drawing point to the virtual model.

Like this, you can quickly draw costumes in KOLO. Use the flat panel tool to convert these lines into paper patterns. The system will automatically arrange and sew the panels for you. Finally, add the fabric, and a piece of clothing is completed.

To make the water wash performance of denim more flexible and intuitive, we have added a material type for single-seam fabric and provided eight preset water wash types:

- Water washing  
- Dry washing  
- Speed washing  
- Slipper washing  
- Acid washing  
- Sterilizing  
- Smell Yang washing  
- Custom-assigned  

These allow you to adjust and test in KOLO. Each water wash model provides different slider options according to the chosen washing method. Each model has cycle time and phonical module options. The longer the time, the lighter the color.

All water wash options can be set consistently. For example, if you have two types of water washing, you can select one type for each. The longer the time, the lighter the color, and the more pronounced the water wash effect.

All water wash options can be selected per type. If you want to use your own water wash effect image, the custom option is perfect. You can add your own water wash image here and use the slider to adjust the details. It only takes a few minutes to create a custom B-pattern water wash visual effect.

The picture shows the effects of eight water wash types.

Now you can implement a version that requires no cutting and sewing. You can apply different textures and colors to this version.

This function is designed to help all real designers create seamless clothing in CLO. CLO offers various workflows to create new seamless division lines, providing unlimited possibilities for seamless clothing creation.

You can use the hook and loop tool to hook the inner line or base line into a seamless division line, then apply different fabrics to the area after division. Just like applying fabric to a version before, you can easily apply fabric to the area after division.

You can also use the seamless division line tool in the edited version to create the original line. After applying different fabrics, you can observe the differences after simulation.

Finally, the seamless division tool itself allows you to create seamless division lines on the version. Then you can apply fabrics after opening the material window. You can also use the edit or edit version tool to adjust the lines you created and use the edit texture tool to adjust the texture of each seamless division.

This way, you can easily create more interesting outfits without cutting any version.

Now you can simulate the software model. Apply the OBJ file for simulation. You can try simulating pillows or sponges.

When you open software model simulation, the virtual model’s shape will change according to the fabric differences. This improvement can also be applied to clothes and accessories like shoulder pads.

After inserting them as OBJ files, adjust the layer order between shoulder pads and clothes first, then turn on simulation.

Now I will apply the software model simulation effect. I can control its rigidity using the slider. This effect is similar to a sponge and improves the realism of clothing created in the shell.

We updated the seamless division tool to show selection and optimize the seamless division display effect, making it better suited for the process unit.

In the seamless attribute editor, you can choose the ratio of the virtual model and edit details including length, width, thickness, and spacing between lines. This makes it easier to check lines in model simulation.

We have further updated the library. Now, when you open it, you will see an independent CONNECT label. In this label, you can check all purchase records and all high-quality resources on the website.

Using the selection option, you can select all resources in CONNECT and narrow the search range to find the content you need.

We have improved the layout of the CLOSE SET in the new library, making it consistent with the webpage layout, which makes it easier to navigate and search for projects.

Now all AI functions are available via the AI button next to the library, making it convenient to access our AI features.

The process and steps for using AI functions remain the same as before. Here, I will use the AI rendering amplifier as an example.

As before, I can upload a rendering image to my work area, enter a prompt, or automatically generate a random prompt to create different AI faces. After selecting the face, you can preview it and use our updated optimization options to further refine the image for a more realistic composite effect.

The last background options in the version can also be found here. I can import an image and preview it, or let CLO generate the background and preview these options.

Once satisfied with the result, you can save the image.

From 2020 to 2021, you could save images. Now I have a new project, which will be uploaded to my work area.

From version 2025.1, all AI functions are off by default. To use AI, you need to activate it manually.

You can activate AI Studio by clicking the plugin in the main menu bar, which redirects you to the official website page where you log in and activate it.

Now you can save the selected version and component as one costume. This makes it easier to extract all parts of a project file and add them to other project files.

For example, I want to save this bag and add it to another project file. With this function, I can easily create a complete set of costumes.

We added a zipper option card to the object window. You can save the zipper for quick and easy application and editing. You can still edit and adjust the zipper separately.

We integrated the fabric generator and the seamless fabric generator into CloFab. You can access CloFab under the fabric window and the fabric option in the main menu bar. It can also be linked to our new CloZFab fabric measurement kit.

In CloFab, you can create fabric information at the top, then enter the fabric attribute section and import your PBR texture.

Use the same process as the previous seamless fabric generator to create a seamless cycle either automatically or manually. After obtaining a satisfactory cycle, enter the physical attribute section.

Follow the same process as in the fabric generator: select the type and components of the fabric, enter the specific percentage and weight of the components, and observe the change in the spiral.

Once satisfied with the physical and visual effects of the fabric, you can save it as a document.

Upon saving, CloLab displays CloLab-poststar and CloLab-purchase documents for you. Then you can import it into the body window and apply it to your outfit.

Now when you add a project or outfit, you can select a color to add.

If the number of flags is fewer than the current file, KOLO will automatically apply the first flag to the rest.

You can add and adjust other flags.

Putting codes in KOLO has never been easier.

Now you can choose which points need codes and which do not. Right-click on the selected point to convert it to a non-code point or a code point.

If a point becomes a non-code point, it will follow the code rules closest to the code point. This also applies to curve points.

We hope this will make it easier for KOLO users to assign codes.

In version 2025.1, we have further updated the quick photo option.

We have added the function of self-defined line shapes and colors to make it easier for everyone to edit different types of lines.

This optimization is for outputting quick photo files.

We hope to improve the usability of quick photo files, so they are not only limited to printing but can also be applied to cutters, making KOLO more convenient for connection and production.

Now you can export and import standard DXF files in KOLO.

In the DXF export/import window, a DXF option appears in the download menu, used for standard DXF files, enhancing compatibility with other CAD software.

Our version generator tool expands AI functionality. Now you can read any image, not just style images.

You can upload your favorite clothing image, and the version generator will create the version based on the image.

Of course, you can continue to edit according to size.

Once satisfied, you can choose to create, and the clothing will be automatically arranged and stored on the virtual model.

All you need to do is simulate and check the wearing effect.

We have added a new feature to the editing version.

It can now align with the page axis, so you don’t need to process repetition manually.

We have added the editing option to the previewer in the new version.

The attribute editor now provides more dropdown options for pick positions.

Cutouts at corners are now more accurately positioned on seams.

We have also updated cutout settings in user custom definitions. This will help all users in unified companies view cutouts more accurately.

We hope these improvements will enhance software usability and provide more accuracy when connecting to production in the future.

There are more functions in KOLO 2025.1.

Please check our official website and follow our new feature introduction videos.

Thank you very much for watching.

I hope you like the updates in this new version and enjoy using these functions.

Have fun creating with KOLO!

chunks.content: # CLO 2025.1 New Features Highlights This document details the new features and improvements introduced in CLO 2025.1, focusing on advanced 3D design tools, fabric simulation, seamless clothing creation, AI enhancements, library updates, and improved compatibility with external software and production workflows. --- ## 3D Pen Virtual Model Tool Enhancements This section covers the upgraded 3D pen tool in CLO 2025.1, enabling creative drawing directly on or off the virtual model in 3D space using shortcut keys, and new drawing aids. - The 3D pen tool now allows drawing both directly on the virtual model surface and freely in 3D space using shortcut keys. - Common shortcut keys remain active during drawing for efficiency. - New functions include: - Adding a circle around the virtual model as a drawing guide. - Displaying the distance from the drawing point to the virtual model for precise control. - After drawing costumes, use the flat panel tool to convert drawn lines into paper patterns. - The system automatically arranges and sews panels. - Finally, applying fabric completes the clothing creation process. --- ## Advanced Water Wash Simulation for Denim This section explains the new material type for single-seam fabric and eight preset water wash types that enhance the realism and flexibility of denim wash effects. - Added a new single-seam fabric material type. - Introduced eight preset water wash types: 1. Water washing 2. Dry washing 3. Speed washing 4. Slipper washing 5. Acid washing 6. Sterilizing 7. Smell Yang washing 8. Custom-assigned - Each water wash type includes specific slider options tailored to the washing method. - Options include cycle time and phonical module; longer cycle times lighten the fabric color. - Multiple water wash types can be applied consistently across different fabric parts. - Custom water wash effects can be created by importing user images and adjusting details with sliders. - Creating a custom B-pattern water wash visual effect takes only a few minutes. --- ## Seamless Clothing Creation Tools This section details new functions for creating seamless clothing without cutting or sewing, including seamless division lines and fabric application workflows. - Supports seamless clothing versions requiring no cutting or sewing. - Various workflows allow creation of new seamless division lines with unlimited design possibilities. - Tools include: - Hook and loop tool: hooks inner line or base line into a seamless division line. - Seamless division line tool: create original lines on the version. - After creating division lines, different fabrics can be applied to each area, similar to traditional fabric application. - Seamless division lines can be edited using the edit or edit version tools. - The edit texture tool allows adjusting textures on each seamless division. - These tools simplify the creation of complex, interesting seamless outfits without altering the garment version. --- ## Software Model Simulation with OBJ Files This section describes the ability to simulate software models using imported OBJ files for enhanced realism in fabric and accessory behavior.

These enhancements aim to streamline the design process, boost creative possibilities, and facilitate more accurate, production-ready outputs.
